name: Seclock
desc:
Order Entry Specialist | Data Entry | $18-$21/hr

What Your Day Will Look Like:
 SECLOCK is the nation's largest door hardware distributor, supplying electrical and mechanical door hardware to customers across the country since 1983. As an Order Entry Specialist, you support the Technical Sales Representatives by entering sales orders accurately and efficiently. Orders come in through several channels, the company website, electronic feeds from customers, direct customer emails, and directly from the sales team, so your day involves moving smoothly between different order sources while keeping speed and accuracy in balance.
 Key responsibilities from the posting:
Enter sales orders received from multiple channels into the company system
Move efficiently between different order types and sources throughout the shift
Communicate clearly and quickly through electronic channels with team members
Maintain accuracy and attention to detail while working at a steady pace
Stay adaptable as business needs and processes evolve
This role rewards someone who enjoys a fast-moving, varied workday and feels energized rather than overwhelmed by switching between tasks. You will be working closely with the sales team to make sure orders move through accurately and on time, giving you a real, visible role in keeping the business running smoothly
assessment: explicit 35 WPM with 99% accuracy requirement, a typing assessment is a reasonable expectation during the application or interview process
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements
 Education Minimum: Not stated in posting.
 Required Experience: None strictly required.
 Preferred Experience: Experience with Microsoft Office, especially Teams and Outlook.
 Required Skills:
Typing speed of at least 35 WPM with 99% accuracy
Strong attention to detail and ability to multitask
Ability to balance speed and quality consistently
Strong interpersonal and electronic communication skills
Positive, team-oriented attitude and comfort with change
 Best Fit
This role is ideal for:
Someone who is fast and accurate with data entry and enjoys a steady, varied pace throughout the day
Participants who want a no-phone remote role with real interaction through written communication
People who are naturally organized and can manage multiple incoming order sources at once
Anyone who thrives in a dynamic environment and adapts well as processes shift
Not a Good Fit for:
Anyone who cannot meet the 35 WPM, 99% accuracy typing requirement
Participants who prefer a slow, single-task daily routine over a fast-paced, multitasking environment
Anyone uncomfortable with frequent change in process or workflow
 Top 10 Resume Keywords:
Order entry
Sales order processing
Data entry accuracy
Microsoft Teams and Outlook
Multitasking
Customer order fulfillment
Remote administrative support
Electronic communication
Attention to detail
Fast-paced data processing
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
 The hiring team focuses on getting to know each applicant's professional skills and experience, and candidates who come prepared with knowledge of the company and the role tend to stand out. Expect a recruiter screening interview, and be ready to demonstrate your typing speed and accuracy as part of the process. Hiring can move quickly once the interview is complete.
Likely interview questions for this role:
How do you stay accurate when you are switching quickly between different types of tasks?
Tell me about a time you had to learn a new process or system quickly and adapt to it.
How do you prioritize when orders are coming in from multiple sources at once?
What does balancing speed and quality look like to you in a data entry role?
other:
The 35 WPM with 99% accuracy requirement is a real, stated bar. Encourage participants to practice and confirm their typing speed before applying.
Career Pathway: Order Entry Specialist → Senior Order Entry Specialist → Order Entry Team Lead → Customer Service Supervisor → Operations Manager
